prior_evidence.exclusion_reason: Run occurred before this confirmatory plan and cannot satisfy pre-registration or repetition requirements.

deterministic-lexical.selection: sort local challenge IDs lexically and select the first eight

random.selection: Python stdlib random.Random(seed).shuffle over the canonical manifest challenge_ids order, followed by the first eight IDs
random.canonical_catalog_order: manifest challenge_ids: D001 through D024, then C001 through C008

jev-guided.ranking: descending expected_defect_weight, then descending raw score, then ascending opaque challenge_ref

metrics.primary: mean selected true defect labels per repetition from 0 through 8
secondary: mean selected critical defect labels per repetition
mean selected clean-negative labels per repetition
unique true defect labels selected across three repetitions
metrics.truth_source: frozen protected corpus truth evaluated locally by the trusted evaluator
metrics.deduplication: count each protected truth challenge ID at most once within the unique-defect secondary metric; repeated selection adds no denominator credit

uncertainty.procedure: initialize rng=random.Random(20261103) exactly once; for iteration 0 through 9999 inclusive, for each arm in fixed order deterministic-lexical, random, jev-guided, append [rng.choice(primary_values) for _ in range(3)] and compute its arithmetic mean
uncertainty.rng_lifetime: one Python stdlib random.Random instance initialized before iteration 0 and reused for every arm and resample
uncertainty.sampling_api: random.Random.choice called three times per arm per bootstrap iteration
uncertainty.repetition_value_order: primary values remain ordered by repetition 1,2,3 before resampling
uncertainty.loop_nesting: outer bootstrap iteration, then fixed arm order, then three inner choice calls
uncertainty.statistic: arithmetic mean of each resampled arm vector
uncertainty.percentile_method: nearest-rank: lower index ceil(0.025*10000)-1 and upper index ceil(0.975*10000)-1 on each sorted bootstrap vector
uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive small-sample uncertainty only, not calibrated evidence of general superiority

jev_wins.bootstrap_lower_bound_requirement: exceed the higher baseline arithmetic mean

decision_rule.permitted_claims: report measured descriptive selection quality only; no causal, general, or superiority claim outside this rule

privacy.successful_response_scan: every JSON string key and value must be checked against the actual credential before return or persistence

conditions: call, retry, or selection ceiling breached
